notes: TEST build. Paint engine v2.1: dry strips are soft and of different widths, some a veil, not a clean double line; a hard press keeps a dry brush down. tool.entropy is the live unevenness of a real brush — every stroke a new dip, the density breathes, the strands regroup. More colours in the brush (tool.colors, colorPattern streaks / split / random / tip) and unmixed paint (material.mix). A canvas weave (surface.weave, weaveSize) in the lab. A covering white covers; thick paint is no longer toothpaste; highlights only on sharp ridges; own sheet wet is really wet.
